title: A CiviCRM post-hook on membership state change yields a lifecycle record that survives an upgrade
content:
The integration is a CiviCRM post-hook dispatching typed operations on membership state change. Membership transitions are the right unit because they are the events an association is actually asked about: when someone joined, when their status changed, and who changed it.

Two acceptance criteria are recorded, and both are external to CiviCRM's own guarantees. The record must survive a CiviCRM upgrade, and it must satisfy an association's audit. The second is a stronger test than a technical one — the record has to be legible to an auditor, not merely present in a table.

The single lead is SYSTOPIA GmbH in Bonn, marked "1 · start here". Its tool column reads "CiviCRM-class membership tooling" rather than CiviCRM outright, so the specific product is characterised by category rather than confirmed; the hook name in the demo text presumes CiviCRM itself, and that presumption is worth checking before the demo is scoped.
